parts: Eighty-two million phones in America are about to get a digital dollar.
Samsung Wallet and Samsung Pay will let US users send USDC, a dollar stablecoin, across borders,
starting in the last week of October.
It runs on the Solana blockchain, but users won't see it.
Built-in on and off ramps convert to and from local money.
That's the shift: crypto rails hidden inside an app people already use,
not a new app they have to learn.
Still unanswered: what transfers cost, and whether users hold their own keys.
Other countries will follow only where local rules allow.
The next wave of blockchain users may never know they're using one.
Eighty-two million phones. Zero new apps.
